name: runtime_epoch
description: One row per epoch boundary with all the epoch-level diffs and results

bank_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number identifying this block within the current run; the join key to runtime_block. Restarts at 1 each time a snapshot is loaded, so pair it with the stream's boot id. 0 means unavailable.

slot.description: First slot of the new epoch

parent_slot.description: Parent slot on this fork (the last replayed slot of the previous epoch)

epoch.description: The new epoch being entered; the boundary snapshot captures stakes as of the end of epoch - 1

total_effective_stake.description: Effective stake across all delegations, recomputed with warmup/cooldown math at this boundary

total_activating_stake.description: Stake activating during the new epoch, recomputed at this boundary

total_deactivating_stake.description: Stake deactivating during the new epoch, recomputed at this boundary

total_epoch_stake.description: Total stake delegated to the valid vote accounts snapshotted at this boundary

num_staked_vote_accounts.description: Vote accounts seen while accumulating delegations at this boundary

num_vote_accounts.description: Vote accounts in the final boundary snapshot

num_top_votes_eligible.description: Vote accounts that passed the validator-admission-ticket filters and were offered to the top-votes set

top_votes_min_stake.description: Smallest stake in the final boundary snapshot - the effective admission threshold

stake_history_sysvar.description: Decoded StakeHistory sysvar entry appended at this boundary

effective.description: Effective stake recorded for the completed epoch

activating.description: Activating stake recorded for the completed epoch

deactivating.description: Deactivating stake recorded for the completed epoch

leader_schedule_slot_offset.description: Slots before an epoch's start at which its leader schedule is computed

warmup.description: True if epochs ramp up from a shorter initial length, false otherwise

first_normal_epoch.description: First epoch of full slots per epoch length

first_normal_slot.description: First slot of first normal epoch

feature_activations.description: Feature ids newly activated at this boundary. The 16-entry bound is operational, not protocol-derived (no boundary on a real cluster has come close); overflow drops the entry with a validator log warning

epoch_rewards_sysvar.description: Decoded EpochRewards sysvar as initialized at this boundary

total_rewards.description: Total lamports minted for this epoch's rewards (vote + stake)

distributed.description: Lamports already distributed when the sysvar was initialized

distribution_starting_block_height.description: Block height at which the stake rewards distribution starts

total_points.description: Total reward points (sum of credits earned times stake across all delegations)

parent_blockhash.description: Parent blockhash seeding the partition hasher

vat_burn_per_vote_account.description: Lamports burned from every admitted vote account at this boundary (SIMD-0357 VAT; alpenglow only, 0 otherwise). The burned set is exactly this boundary's runtime_vote_account rows, so the aggregate burned is this value times that row count. The debits are not emitted as account diffs, and the incinerator credit is not observable in runtime_block.other_diffs either: the incinerator is drained to zero later in the same block by fd_runtime_freeze, so its coalesced diff is 0 -> 0
